import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", ctypes.c_double),
        ("err", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the sin_pi function
def sin_pi(x):
    result = GslSfResult()
    gsl.gsl_sf_sin_pi_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    return result.val

# Define the cos_pi function
def cos_pi(x):
    result = GslSfResult()
    gsl.gsl_sf_cos_pi_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    return result.val

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test cases for sin_pi
    assert abs(sin_pi(0.0) - 0.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for sin_pi(0.0)"
    assert abs(sin_pi(0.5) - 1.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for sin_pi(0.5)"
    assert abs(sin_pi(-0.5) + 1.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for sin_pi(-0.5)"
    assert abs(sin_pi(1.0) - 0.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for sin_pi(1.0)"

    # Test cases for cos_pi
    assert abs(cos_pi(0.0) - 1.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for cos_pi(0.0)"
    assert abs(cos_pi(0.5) - 0.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for cos_pi(0.5)"
    assert abs(cos_pi(-0.5) - 0.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for cos_pi(-0.5)"
    assert abs(cos_pi(1.0) + 1.0) < 1e-10, "Test case failed for cos_pi(1.0)"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
